items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Draws Fresh ETF Buying, Is The Stock Already Pricey?
items.summary: ETF flows have swung sharply toward Analog Devices (ADI) after semiconductor funds led by SOXX bought a net $311.1 million of the stock on November 9, reversing recent outflows. That ETF interest lands on a stock that has already been in motion, with Analog Devices trading at $409.29 after a 7 day share price return of 13.37%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 74.47% indicates notable momentum even after a recent 30 day share price dip of 1.30%.
